idea: Clamp SwiGLU activations in every MLP: gate=gate.clamp(max=6.0), up=up.clamp(-6.0,6.0) before silu(gate)*up
evidence: DeepSeek-V4 reports SwiGLU clamping as a practical instability/outlier fix; results.tsv only tried ReLU2 activation (a6db89c) and HybridNorm (99930a8), not preserving SwiGLU while clipping outliers.
notes: No params and tiny code change. Targets the repeated pattern where lower train loss failed to transfer by limiting activation outliers while keeping smooth SiLU. Risk: if current model has no outlier issue, clamp may underfit.

idea: Output embedding mu-centering: use centered lm_head weight W - mean(W, dim=0) for logits, keep logit_mult and softcap=15
evidence: arxiv:2601.02031 says output embedding centering suppresses logit divergence and works with soft-capping; results.tsv shows output scale geometry is load-bearing via f5a9cd9/c1d383e/5b4910a but no output-centering test.
notes: No parameter increase. Targets lm_head anisotropy rather than changing softcap. Risk: centering may conflict with muP lm_head init or reduce useful unigram bias.

idea: Use grouped-query attention with n_kv_head 6->3 while keeping n_head=6 and head_dim=128
evidence: Qwen3.6 Gated Attention uses far fewer KV heads than Q heads; GQA is a frontier default. d44e564 only ruled out MLA latent K/V bottleneck, not direct KV-head sharing via existing enable_gqa path.
notes: Reduces K/V/value_emb params and may regularize attention while improving speed. Still above 200M params. Refresh autotune after size change. Risk: K/V capacity may be too important at 6 heads.

idea: Add L3-style context-gated token lookup adapter in MLP-only layer 13: 2^15 x 128 token table, gate from norm(x), project 128->768, alpha init 0
evidence: arxiv:2601.21461 L3 reports static token-routed lookup layers beating dense and MoE baselines; fde4025 only ruled out naive additive 2^16 bigram table before x0, not a small context-gated mid-layer lookup.
notes: Keeps memory table small and contextual to avoid the bigram overfit failure. Uses an MLP-only layer to add lexical memory without extra attention. Risk: token lookup may still overfit ClimbMix BPB.

idea: Cheap 2-step MTP proxy: predict hash(target_{t+1}) into 4096 classes with small auxiliary head, weight 0.05 after warmup
evidence: d748827 proved full shared-vocab MTP is too slow but explicitly left cheaper sampled/low-rank/small-head MTP open; Qwen3.6 and DeepSeek-V4 still use MTP.
notes: Avoids second full 50257-way CE and should preserve throughput. Auxiliary target is a hash bucket, eval NTP unchanged. Risk: hashed future target may be too noisy or not align with BPB.

idea: Add learned lm_head bias initialized to 0 and trained with AdamW at unembedding_lr, logits = lm_head(x)+bias before logit_mult/softcap
evidence: arxiv:2603.10145 says the LM head is a gradient bottleneck; results.tsv has no output/unigram bias test and softcap/logit_mult results show output interface geometry is critical.
notes: Cheap 50k-param token prior can model unigram frequency outside the hidden-rank bottleneck. Risk: bias may overfit frequent tokens or interact with BPB byte weighting.

idea: Reduce partial RoPE fraction from 50% to 25% of each 128-d head while keeping RoPE base=10000 and QK RMSNorm
evidence: Qwen3.6 Gated Attention uses RoPE dim 64 with head dim 256 (25%); arxiv:2603.11611 finds small RoPE fractions can converge comparably; results.tsv only tried RoPE base=50000 and head_dim=64 confound, not rotary fraction.
notes: Frees more head dims for content while retaining positional signal. No params. Risk: d0c5eba suggests too little positional capacity can hurt, but that was confounded by 12 heads/head_dim64.

idea: NAMO-style Muon scalar adaptation: after Newton-Schulz orthogonalization, scale each matrix update by one Adam-like scalar from update-norm EMA, no diagonal preconditioning
evidence: arxiv:2602.17080 reports NAMO improves GPT-2 pretraining over Muon at negligible cost; 240982f NorMuon and 5274596 VAM failed different mechanisms (dynamic LR/pre-NSR variance), not post-NS scalar adaptation.
notes: Targets optimizer sample efficiency without changing forward pass or per-head geometry. Risk: current custom Muon scaling is already tuned and extra adaptation may overfit like VAM.

idea: Add one learned global ve_gain scalar multiplying existing value_emb injection, init 1.0: v += ve_gain * gate * ve
evidence: VE capacity increases and VE WD failed (580c70a,94d986b), but no experiment lets model down/up-regulate existing shared VE strength while preserving the useful shared VE prior.
notes: Starts exactly at current best architecture and can learn to reduce VE overfit or increase helpful token-value signal. Very low param cost. Risk: scalar may stay near 1 and be noise-level.

idea: Add parallel low-rank residual LM head: logits += alpha * (silu(x@A)@B), rank=128, alpha init 0, before softcap
evidence: arxiv:2603.10145 argues standard LM head suppresses 95-99% of gradient norm; no prior experiment changes LM head rank/Jacobian except scalar logit_mult.
notes: Tests whether a small nonlinear output path improves gradient flow and softmax expressivity without full second vocab head. Adds ~6.5M params and modest compute. Risk: extra vocab projection may slow training or overfit.
